senses.gloss: m. (רְבֵי) fat, esp. = h. חֵלֶב, (forbidden) abdominal fat.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 30a:1">Bekh. 30ᵃ</cite> top <he>ת׳ דאטמא</he> the fat of the flank (on the kidneys).
<cite ref="Chullin 93a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>תלתא משום ת׳</he> three (of the membranes) are forbidden as coming under the category of fat; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תַּרְבַּיָּיא</he>, <he>תַּרְבִּין</he>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 7:7">Targ. II Chr. VII, 7</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 80a:17">Ḥull. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>שרי תַרְבַּיְיהוּ</he> permitted to eat their fat.
